## What changes

<!-- One paragraph. What does this do that the repository did not do before? -->

## What breaks if this is wrong

<!--
The most useful line in a review. If the answer is "nothing", this may not need a PR.
-->

## How it was verified

<!--
Not "tests pass". Which job did you run, on which commit, and what did you see?
A run number or command output is enough.
-->

- [ ] Documentation updated in the same commit (behaviour and text cannot drift)
- [ ] No credential, key or account identifier added to a tracked file
- [ ] If a workflow job changed: the affected job was run and its result observed
- [ ] If an IAM policy changed: the new action was added by name, scoped to a resource
